your_book:
Tuesday was a rough session for Jaleel's book, with broad-based selling across the largest positions dragging the portfolio lower. The two deepest single-day wounds came from AutoZone (AZO, –3.55%) and Adobe (ADBE, –2.95%), both hit by macro-driven rotation out of growth and consumer names amid escalating Middle East tensions and renewed inflation concerns — the ADBE headline makes the catalyst explicit. Boston Scientific (BSX, –2.62%) and On Holding (ONON, –2.58%) piled on, the former already carrying an elevated risk flag for its guidance slash. Neurocrine Biosciences (NBIX) fell –4.58% on no apparent company-specific news, which warrants a closer look given its Strong Buy rating and highest QARP score in the book (81.2). The lone bright spots were Danaher (DHR, +3.01%), NVIDIA (NVDA, +0.57%), Rocket Lab (RKLB, +1.6%), and Expand Energy (EXE, +0.89%).

The drift problem is getting harder to ignore. LULU sits –23.1% with a guidance-cut risk flag and a Nike 52-week-low as a sector echo; BSX is –10.5% with management guiding flat through Q3; ONON is –14.8%; RKLB is –18.9% and carries an Avoid verdict at a QARP of 39.2. These are positions where price and thesis are clearly diverging — several are rated Strong Buy, but the losses are compounding and the fundamental backdrops on LULU and BSX are actively deteriorating, not simply being mispriced by a noisy market.

Watch the macro setup closely into week-end: key economic data flagged in the ADBE headline could accelerate the growth-to-value rotation that punished the book today. NBIX's sharp drop without a visible catalyst needs a reason. And RKLB — up today but down nearly 19% overall with an Avoid verdict — remains the clearest structural misfit in a capital-preservation-minded book.

attention.headline: Avoid-rated, –18.9% unrealized, no strategic fit
attention.note: RKLB carries the book's only Avoid verdict, its lowest QARP score (39.2) by a wide margin, and a nearly 19% loss — in a capital-preservation book that flag combination demands a justification or an exit decision.

attention.headline: –4.58% today with no visible catalyst
attention.note: Neurocrine's session drop was the sharpest in the book on Tuesday and came with no accompanying headline, which is unusual for a smaller-weight, high-conviction Strong Buy — the source of selling needs to be identified before assuming it's noise.

attention.headline: Guidance slashed, –10.5% unrealized, –2.62% today
attention.note: Boston Scientific's elevated risk flag (growth cut from 10.5% to 7–8.5%, management guiding flat through Q3) combined with today's drop and a deepening unrealized loss makes the Strong Buy thesis increasingly hard to hold without a specific catalyst in view before the Oct 28 print.

attention.headline: –23.1% unrealized, guidance cut active, sector bleeding
attention.note: Lululemon's loss is the deepest in the book, the guidance-cut flag is live (Americas comps –5% for a fifth straight quarter), and today's Nike 52-week-low headline signals the broader consumer discretionary backdrop is not recovering — the Strong Buy verdict needs a clear recheck against current fundamentals.
